records.title: Oil jumps more than 1% after US attack on Iran's Larak island

records.claim: US forces struck two Iranian launchers on Larak Island; a US official said IRGC forces were preparing to launch rockets with sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz.
records.title: US forces strike two Iranian launchers on Iran's Larak island, US official says
records.boundary: Based on a US official and subsequent reported retaliation; military claims remain subject to later confirmation.

records.claim: Visible commodity vessel transits through Hormuz over the weekend fell to about five per day.
records.title: Oil jumps more than 1% after US attack on Iran's Larak island
records.boundary: Visible-vessel shipping-data count; AIS visibility and later revisions can change the figure.

records.claim: PetroChina H1 crude processing fell 5.6%, gasoline/kerosene/diesel sales fell 8.8%, while total natural-gas sales rose 3.9%.
records.title: PetroChina H1 profit jumps 22%, fuel sales fall as China demand weakens
records.boundary: Half-year cumulative issuer data; structural, not an intraday China spot-market indicator.

records.claim: Venezuela's interim president said a US-Venezuela energy arrangement would last 25 years and target more than 1.5 million bpd from 17 strategic oilfields.
records.title: Venezuela's interim president says US energy deal will last 25 years
records.boundary: Agreement target/forward plan, not realized incremental production.

records.claim: Trump said Venezuelan oil from the new arrangement would be used to replenish the US SPR; Reuters reported about 290 million barrels in the reserve as of Aug. 21.
records.title: Trump says US will refill Strategic Petroleum Reserve using Venezuelan oil
records.boundary: No firm timing/volume mechanics for replenishment; Venezuela production expansion requires investment and infrastructure.

records.claim: ONEOK agreed to buy Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland gas gathering and processing assets for about $4.43bn, more than doubling its regional processing capacity.
records.title: ONEOK to buy Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland Basin assets for $4.43 billion
records.boundary: Transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions; capacity includes assets/projects not equivalent to immediate new gas supply.
